title.label: There is a bug in the keyboard app: running in the background prevents the screen from turning off.

content.label:
Issue: System auto-lock fails due to background activity.
Description: My iPhone is set to auto-lock after 30 seconds. However, once this keyboard app is used, it stays running in the background and overrides the system's auto-lock setting, keeping the screen awake.
Workaround: Normal auto-lock behavior is only restored after I manually force quit the app from the app switcher.
